posts.author: Tokeitawa
posts.body:
I am having problems with making the game 640x480.
Using Yanfly's Ace Engine does resize the game window, but creates black borders all around it. So I stumbled upon WindMesser's scripts which works but when creating smaller maps i.e 17x13. It makes the map have this weird grid effect, and snapping all over. My computer resolution is 1980x1080 so I don't see why would changing size to 640x480.
The game with Windmesser's 640x480 Script
The game with Yanfly's Ace Engine
Thanks in advance!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
First, can you confirm which engine you're using?
VX and VXAce are different programs with only limited compatibility.
Second, the difference is likely that the first script is zooming while yanfly's script is increasing the screen size. And a larger screen requires a larger map - you get the borders because the map is too small.
a 640x480 screen size requires a minimum map size of 20x15 tiles to have enough pixel to fil that area.
